title: Wizard in Magical Courtyard
description: A smiling elderly wizard with a long grey beard stands in a sunlit Mediterranean courtyard, wearing a colorful patchwork robe and tall pointed hat. He holds a glowing wand in one hand and points with the other, surrounded by hanging stained-glass lanterns, flowering vines, and a vibrant tree.
prompt: An elderly wizard with a long grey beard and smiling expression stands in a bright sunlit courtyard with white stucco walls and tiled floors. He wears a tall multicolored patchwork wizard hat and ornate blue and gold robes. In his right hand he holds a glowing magical wand with swirling light, while pointing with his left hand. Colorful stained-glass lanterns in teardrop shapes hang from an ornate metal frame and tree branches. Flowering vines with pink and purple blossoms climb the walls and hang from above. A vibrant tree with multicolored leaves stands behind him, bright daylight, highly detailed fantasy scene.
